references.text: The Levites were appointed to carry the tabernacle and take care of it, which explains their central position during the journey.
Describes how the tabernacle was taken down and carried by the sons of Gershon and Merari during the journey.
The Kohathites carried the holy objects, and the tabernacle was set up before they arrived.
The Israelites were to camp by their own banners, which corresponds with them breaking camp in the same order.
The sons of Kohath had responsibility for carrying the holy objects when the camp broke up.
The tent of meeting was set up and the glory of the Lord filled it, showing the central importance of the tent in Israel's camp.
When Israel crossed the Jordan, the ark of the covenant went before the people, similar to the central position of the tent of meeting during the journey.
